scope: RefLog express local branch single/submenu and immediate owned native Switch progress with source success/failure/merge-conflict/retry post-actions. Partial parity; full application port remains incomplete.

verification.core: CheckoutTests 7 passed. Checkout adds optional cancellation, checked before preparation and forwarded to the final Git switch process; ordinary callers retain their behavior.
verification.native: Final express-switch receiver passed system Git, 2.37.1, 2.39.5 and bundled 2.55.0. Model branch candidates sorted single/multiple local refs; active branch/remote/tag exclusion and other branch at HEAD eligibility. Empty/stale/multi/busy/chooser/invalidation and bare guards checked. Actual native progress model performs checkout, captures previous branch, selects success post-actions and dispatches captured Merge callback. Dirty failure preserves HEAD/index/file; explicit merge produces actual index conflicts and failed progress despite Git exit zero, Resolve/Retry menu, then succeeds after fixture reset and retry. Missing branch, pre-cancelled operation preserving HEAD, detached-source and gitlink submodule post-actions, original icon mapping checked. Receivers create models only: no windows, preferences, clipboard or external apps. Final matrix also proves express menu eligibility with unresolved unborn HEAD and actual switch into existing topic from a clean no-checkout clone.
verification.iterations: Initial Debug and SwiftPM compile failed because await appeared in the synchronous right-hand autoclosure of &&. Both sessions were terminal before the correction. Extracted async conflict read into a separate statement and cleared partial success actions before failure actions. Final Debug, CheckoutTests and four-Git native matrix passed. Failed logs retained. Final source review removed an extra resolved-HEAD guard from express switching, which source does not require; added an actual unborn-to-existing branch fixture. Debug rebuilt before rerunning final native matrix. Final express-switch receiver passed all four Git versions including unborn fixture.
verification.documentation: Parity notes, NOTICE, four upstream inventory mappings and macOS workflow updated. Pin checker and all 3277 seven-column source rows passed. Local site generated; unpublished.
verification.limitations: Physical context-menu layout/sheet rendering/window ownership, close/cancel handlers and actual post-action factory/refresh routing unverified. Only pre-cancellation is exercised; process interruption is delegated to existing cancellable Git runtime and not separately exercised here. Signed repository access, streaming output, progress persistence, Stash follow-up Pull flag and broader Switch options progress integration pending. Current/adjacent stash express-menu predicates share existing gates but are not separately exercised by this receiver. Full RefLog/context/dialog/Finder parity, updated real screenshots/manual, hosted CI/publication and signed App Store distribution remain incomplete. GitHub authentication unavailable; not retried.
verification.regression: Remote Switch defaults receiver passed all four Git versions after progress/menu changes, before only the final removal of express switch resolved-HEAD guard and its new unborn fixture. Final express receiver compiles all native Sources. Remote receiver verifies actual Switch defaults, symbolic remote selection, moved-ref refresh, read-only state and tracked Core branch creation.
verification.builds: Final unsigned Debug and AppStore builds passed. Both bundle audits and exact bundled NOTICE comparisons passed. All 96 original icons verified. Store --require-git audited 11 universal Git 2.55.0 Mach-O files and real fixture operations. EditorConfig/IssueRegex audits passed.
